sentences.en: A good mediator can make a deal go smoothly.
sentences.zh: 一个好的调解人可以使交易顺利进行。

sentences.en: The mediator knows better the culture of the woman.
sentences.zh: 这位调解人更了解那位女士的文化背景。

sentences.en: Music is the mediator between the spiritual and the sensual life.
sentences.zh: 音乐是精神生活和感官生活的媒介。

senses.zh: 调解人，调停人，斡旋者；仲裁组织
